formal.statement: theorem declared_resultant_root_audit_certificate : (∀ (F : Type*) [Field F] [IsAlgClosed F] (f g : F[X]) (m n : ℕ), 0<m → 0<n → f.natDegree≤m → g.natDegree≤n → (Polynomial.resultant f g m n=0 ↔ (∃ a : F,f.eval a=0 ∧ g.eval a=0) ∨ (f.coeff m=0 ∧ g.coeff n=0))) ∧ (∀ (F : Type*) [Field F], ¬ ∀ f g : F[X],f.natDegree≤2 → g.natDegree≤2 → Polynomial.resultant f g 2 2=0 → ∃ a : F,f.eval a=0 ∧ g.eval a=0) ∧ (Polynomial.resultant rationalNoRoot rationalNoRoot 2 2=0 ∧ rationalNoRoot.coeff 2≠0 ∧ ¬ ∃ a : ℚ,rationalNoRoot.eval a=0 ∧ rationalNoRoot.eval a=0)
formal.scope: Over an algebraically closed field, positive declared sizesm,n and degree bounds imply resultant zero iff common finite root OR both declared leading coefficients vanish. Direct universal affine-only claim refuted by padded constant1/constant1over every field; closure removal refuted by actual full-degree X²+1overQ. Pure polynomial theorem; no projective-space construction or geometric Semaev recursion proof.
